policy: Evidence-based freeze. FROZEN_FOR_FRONT forbids breaking route/field/enum semantics. STABLE_ADDITIVE_ONLY permits additive optional fields through expand/contract discipline. NOT_FROZEN requires the frontend to keep UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE handling and must not be treated as a production blocker unless listed as P0_BEFORE_FRONT_FREEZE.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: meta, permissions and data envelope shape cannot be removed or renamed.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Optional meta fields and additive view data fields.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Existing view, command, capability and event paths cannot be removed or renamed.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: New views, commands and optional query parameters.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: ACCEPTED receipt, idempotencyKey, correlationId, commandId and brokerExecution=false semantics cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Optional audit/runtime diagnostics.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Stable code/status/category/severity/retryable/operator_message fields cannot be removed.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: New registered error codes and optional technical details.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: signal_id, strategy version/instance lineage, timing, dedupe and no-provider side effect semantics cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Optional context/provenance fields and additive reason metadata.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: TAKE/TAKE_REDUCED/WAIT/REJECT decision semantics, confidence and fail-safe fields cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional evidence slices, anomalies and source references.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Decision enums, fail-safe WAIT and no-direct-execution invariant cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Reason codes, anomalies and optional provenance.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Allocation lineage and conflict outcomes cannot be removed or reinterpreted.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional conflict diagnostics and attribution fields.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: APPROVED/REDUCED/REJECTED and PASS/REDUCE/BLOCK semantics, requested/approved size and lineage cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Reason codes, policy metadata and exposure diagnostics.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Risk-approved target and immutable Portfolio/Risk lineage semantics cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Optional pricing and exposure diagnostics.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Post-risk terms, idempotency, target/risk lineage and broker_submission_allowed semantics cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Optional execution metadata and display explanations.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Confirmation/rejection/expiry, revision, operator audit and immutable terms cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: New fail-closed terminal state or reason metadata through expand/contract.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Backend must remain authoritative for allowed/denied actions; frontend must fail closed when actions are absent.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional actions and denial reasons.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Official target/risk/order intent values remain backend-sourced and cannot move to frontend calculation.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional rollups, attribution and drilldown links.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Risk state, limits, stale/degraded semantics and no-front-risk-calculation invariant cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional risk limits and explanations.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Session identity, freshness and unavailable semantics cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional timeline/context sections.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Correlation/audit/read-only semantics and no-secret guarantee cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional event sources and richer relation graph.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Severity/status/stale semantics and operator-safe messages cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Additional incident categories and action hints.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: Current fields should remain while recovery semantics converge.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Aggregate/revision/source/receivedAt and recovery metadata.
contracts.reason: Only selected event streams have complete persisted cursor/gap evidence; frontend must keep refetch/resubscribe fallback.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: ACK must not become FILL; idempotency and provider-neutral command semantics cannot regress.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: Provider-neutral optional fields and new guarded commands/events.

contracts.breakingChangeProhibition: No destructive change before legacy frontend retirement.
contracts.allowedAdditiveChanges: OpenAPI-compatible additive routes/fields.
